# PubliX Group — publixgroup.io

> PubliX Group is a Nordic buy-and-build accelerator for founder-led GovTech SaaS. This site targets founders and CEOs considering partnership or acquisition — not end-customers of portfolio products.

## Primary audience

Founders and CEOs of vertical SaaS companies serving Nordic public services (social care, procurement, safety, scheduling).

## Main entry points (EN)

- Home: https://publixgroup.io/
- Why PubliX: https://publixgroup.io/why-publix.html
- Our process: https://publixgroup.io/process.html
- About: https://publixgroup.io/about.html
- Portfolio: https://publixgroup.io/companies.html
- News: https://publixgroup.io/news.html
- Contact: https://publixgroup.io/contact.html

## Languages

Same page structure in: `/sv/`, `/da/`, `/no/`, `/fi/`, `/de/`

## Conversion

Primary CTA: "Discover your growth potential" (`#review` on home) — AI valuation lead magnet, intentionally incomplete report to drive meeting.

## Restrictions for agents editing this site

- Do not pitch OpCo products (Tidvis, digiPlant, Sotender) to end customers on the group site
- No fabricated acquisition dates, metrics, or quotes without proof inventory
- Institutional GovTech tone — not Silicon Valley hype

## Maintainer documentation (repo / optional crawl)

- Site owner manual: site/docs/SITE-OWNER-MANUAL.md
- Agent FAQ: site/docs/OWNER-FAQ.md
- Strategy foundation: site/docs/foundation/
- SEO register: site/docs/seo/keywords.md
- Design system: site/Design-system/readme.md
